svg.title: Ankush — Machine Learning · Software Engineering
svg.desc: Animated banner. An image is split into patches, the patches flow through the layers of a vision-language model, and a caption is typed out: a sun setting behind two peaks. A typed line cycles through: fine-tuning vision-language models, fine-tuning Qwen3 language models, serving models with vLLM, building backends with Python and Kafka, shipping on Kubernetes and Terraform.
